correctness.rationale: Using the compact-interior invariant measure, L(log v)=−mv+qu/(1+cu) yields the exact stationary predator balance. The algebraic identity u−b=(1+cb)(u−b)/(1+cu)+c(u−b)^2/(1+cu) yields a nonnegative exact Jensen defect with coefficient qc/(1+cb)^2. Generator test Lv and Cauchy–Schwarz with qu/(1+cu) being q-Lipschitz give Cov(v,qu/(1+cu))=m Var(v) and m²Var(v)≤q²Var(u). Vanishing mean defect forces constant u; strict monotonicity of prey drift in v forces the unique positive equilibrium. Independently checked the rational identities by SymPy; no dynamics is inferred from sample trajectories.
